source: a game about cute animals who go to school, who have to guess the right answer for their subjects at school (the intro is set in a classroom) and if they get it wrong it turns into a dark setting where the player has to run

image_prompt.text: The classroom floor split into evenly marked answer quadrants the animal players stand on to choose their answer to each subject question
The classroom itself as the gathering space - desks in rows facing the board, the whole class in it between questions
The dark place a wrong answer drops you into: an unlit running ground with a pursuing danger closing behind the player

layout_placement.text: The transition that pulls a player out of the classroom and into the dark zone when they answer wrong, and returns survivors afterwards

notes: No preset taken. The Quiz preset matches the classroom half exactly but carries a continuous play space, and this prompt has two environments the player is moved between - the bright classroom and the dark running ground - so the shape was tuned to the isolated stage instead. That costs P4.
Mixed classification: the quiz loop is Party & Casual, the punishment is Survival's threat evasion. Party is dominant because the classroom is where the game is played from.

The prompt never says what the player is running from. The hazard is placed as a region because that is the cheaper reading; if it is a pursuing character it becomes a spawner and the dark zone needs loop topology with no dead ends.

open_questions.ask: What is chasing the player in the dark zone - a creature, a collapsing floor, a rising darkness?
Does a player who survives the dark zone come back to the classroom, or are they out for the round?

theme: Stylized / Toon in the classroom, flipping to Horror in the dark zone

coverage_missing.ask: What is the threat in the dark zone?
What happens after the dark zone - respawn, elimination, back to class?
How many players are in a class at once?
Is the dark zone one shared space, or does each wrong answer get its own?

answers.ask: What is chasing the player in the dark zone - a creature, a collapsing floor, a rising darkness?
answers.answer: A dark creature chases the player through the dark zone.

answers.ask: Does a player who survives the dark zone come back to the classroom, or are they out for the round?
answers.answer: A player who survives returns to the classroom to continue answering subjects.
